title: Dead Event
description:
Early Access Supporter Pack Included!
Every creature you make during early access gets a exclusive Supporter Pack as a thank you for helping the game grow. (no pun intended) Includes: Head start over full release players, Bug Detective Hat, Growth Heirloom Addon for faster leveling(+Growth Experience Rate and +Gold Rate)

Об игре
• Grow bigger overtime with idle growth experience every 5 minutes and with in-game interactions. Thrive in a player based ecosystem, choose from 13 different species of creatures to play and more creatures planned for the future. Fight other creatures and monsters while you explore the world.

• 250+ unique items to find, all items have random bonus RNG statistics, even two of the exact same item won't be the same.

• Customizable creature statistics, every creature is unique, max level is 101 along with endless attribute gain and increased size each level.

• Group up with a Herd and share experience and items. Form a Colony and give some of your growth experience to grow the colony to unlock colony skills.

• Open World PvPvE

• Quest, harvest, craft, build, weather, world and holiday events, cosmetics-hats & skins and overlays.

• Death penalty is you lose 1% of your growth experience on death and your current growth bar progress however a colony skill call redemption can reduce this.
 Join our helpful for more information, help, support and friends. The community feedback shapes the game, come grow with us!

Dead Event is a indie MMORPG survival game in which the player grows up as a creature. The creature will grow bigger overtime and with interactions in-game also lose some growth on death. Form a colony or hunt alone, become part of a player-created ecosystem. Survive, eat or be eaten...
